runPolicy.baselineRunIds: private create-once binding maps each slot to five distinct baseline IDs before first baseline attempt
runPolicy.candidateRunIds: Gate 5 target assigns five new IDs keyed to target identity and slots; all differ from baseline IDs
runPolicy.attemptBinding: every attempt/resource/bundle/target binds definition SHA-256, private binding SHA-256, slot and resolved run ID
runPolicy.ordering: prestate; startup/idle; warm; app-cache-cold; process/pool-cold; DB/OS-cold; admin; map; providers; inference; maintenance; one-shots; exact restore; poststate
runPolicy.restoration: capture group pre-state; execute all successors; invoke mandatory group finalizer on success/failure/timeout/cancellation; retain restore receipt before next group

coldPolicy.meaning: five distinct detached volume names bound one-to-one to run slots; not five allocated copies
coldPolicy.allocation: actual copy count and topology require storage approval plus fresh admission; prospective deletion credit forbidden
coldPolicy.proof: retain full raw existing D-loop fadvise/mincore proof and supervisor observation per sample; bind storage/runtime/startup/sample identities; reject replay/missing bytes
coldPolicy.claimLimit: ordered fadvise/mincore witness only; no unmount, direct-I/O, controller, Windows or universal-cold claim

provider-standard-150s.slowCassetteRule: hold each provider response beyond the fixed 10000ms attempt timeout; source retry/deadline logic remains unmodified

bindingSlotTypes.identity.measurementCommit: 40-hex commit containing definition, binding schema/builder, selectors, observer/evaluator/resource/cold support bytes
bindingSlotTypes.identity.sharedDataConfigModelCassette: SHA-256 aggregate of immutable shared baseline/candidate data, config, topology, model and cassette receipts
bindingSlotTypes.topology.*: validated topology receipt field; fixed origin/cgroup/limit/environment, never caller URL/path
bindingSlotTypes.snapshot.*: content-addressed field derived from admitted raw native snapshot receipt
bindingSlotTypes.secret.*: protected runtime handle supplied outside argv/env/evidence; secret value and digest forbidden
bindingSlotTypes.admin.*: derived by committed closed selectors from validated disposable admin before-state
bindingSlotTypes.map.*: derived from site config, UTC frame rule, cassette and exact usage-ledger receipt
bindingSlotTypes.provider.*: source/checkpoint/window/config/cassette field derived from complete admitted source snapshot and process-level cassette receipt
bindingSlotTypes.model.*: installed-equivalent artifact/input bytes and receipt; synthetic fixture cannot satisfy
bindingSlotTypes.maintenance.*: canonical validated request bytes and predecessor receipts derived from admitted capture epoch/source snapshot
bindingSlotTypes.oneshot.*: closed selected source ID/date/path/hash/package/input from admitted snapshot; only operation-declared slots accepted
bindingSlotTypes.selector.*: output of the named committed closed selector; direct caller value forbidden
bindingSlotTypes.provenance.*: phase-specific source/release/image/live identity validated from canonical live/source evidence; not stored in or backfilled into the shared private workload binding
bindingSlotTypes.transition.*: exact same-run predecessor output or in-memory secret handle; committed validator/composer only; secret values never enter evidence, hashes, argv or environment; nonsecret transitions are raw/hash-chained; never caller supplied
bindingSlotTypes.worker.*: validated worker pre-state derived from admitted database/topology receipt, including exact empty due-source set when declared
bindingSlotTypes.reference.*: validated immutable weather-backend-benchmark-reference/v2 receipt field; data/calendar reference only; never caller supplied and never safety, authorization, lease, timeout, trust, commit, receipt, measurement or host authority

rules: children are exactly three and index-equal to familyOrder temperature/wind/rain; no implementation selects cardinality
each child is exactly weather-benchmark-monthly-input-child/v1 with orderedChildExactKeys; no childInputSha256 or other per-child digest field exists
expectedCompletedWorkCount is an integer greater than zero for every child and is derived before baseline/candidate execution from the admitted corpus

familyInputAggregateRootSha256 is SHA-256 over its literal versioned domain plus canonical familyOrder, the three complete immutable child core bytes, preStateProjectionSha256 and expectedRestoredStateProjectionSha256; it excludes itself and every phase receipt
monthlyInputsSha256 is an external digest of the complete immutable slot bytes including familyInputAggregateRootSha256; it is never embedded in that slot
if the admitted corpus cannot satisfy all three exact children/outcomes/nonempty counts, binding fails before metrics; no child is skipped or weakened

one existing operation, one validated-one-shot-execution completed work unit and one atomic-group restore remain; child counts and aggregate roots are evidence, not operations, attempts, work units, slots or transitions

closedSelectors.admin-settings: validate version=1 booleans; preserve temperature/wind and invert rain; emit canonical JSON; reject if before-state invalid
closedSelectors.admin-layout: validate all entries and the bound site center; select the lexicographically smallest sensorKey whose coordinates are within latitude +/-0.025 and longitude +/-0.04 of center; preserve coordinates; preserve a valid air-quality/rain/temperature/wind icon or use temperature for a legacy null icon; set displayName to 'G002 benchmark' unless already equal, then 'G002 benchmark 2'; server alone supplies updatedAt; reject when no eligible entry exists
closedSelectors.map-frame: history/radar; zoom=10; 256x168; site latitude/longitude from validated site config to six decimals; validTime is the latest fully closed ten-minute UTC frame strictly before binding creation
closedSelectors.provider-source: select the exact declared provider family source from the complete due-source snapshot; reject zero, duplicate or extra due sources; require unmodified source defaults timeoutMs=10000, maxAttempts=3, maximum retry delay=30000ms, provider budget=90000ms and run deadline=120000ms or fail binding/re-review
closedSelectors.backfill-input: site=ballydidean; select lexicographically smallest active source/station with a complete admitted cassette; select its earliest complete one-day historical cassette window; from=to for that day
closedSelectors.performance-package: select the lexicographically smallest complete matched forecast/adjustment package pair and same-cohort manifest pair; reject mixed or incomplete pairs
closedSelectors.run-ids: binding writer generates five unique baseline IDs for ordered slots; target writer generates five different candidate IDs keyed to target identity and the same slots

api-core-private-topology.rustV1: weather-api replacement on same private topology

retainInstead: cookie attribute names and validation result
nonsecret canonical body when operation declares it
redactionPolicy.denominator: redaction never removes an attempt, outcome, byte count, timeout, cancellation or resource interval

groups.execution: strata-order: warm-all; app-cache-cold-applicable; process-pool-cold-all; db-os-cold-all; operation order as listed within each stratum
